g.text: An exploratory current–diel test does not establish tide specificity

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #546278

g.text: 27 Magellanic penguins | 1 colony/coast | 2 held-out calendar weeks | 3,334 primary 15-minute bins

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #46546a

g.text: Scores average animals within weeks, then weeks. Points are settings/models, not independent studies or confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #46546a

g.text: The original naive animal clock is interpreted using author metadata. Scalar-speed controls shifted by ±6 h correlate ≈0.991 with real speed.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #46546a

g.text: Failure to distinguish these similar clocks does not imply absence of tidal influence. The eight-week confirmatory gate is unmet.
